第1975章 一下子乱了节奏（第1页）
顾少卿将她给抱着，不让她给摔着。
心里也是喜悦的很。“我也想你。”君雅思微微松开了顾少卿的脖子，看着眼前的男人，心里的高兴更是快要从胸膛满溢。
此刻再也说不出其他的言语来，只想要好好的与他亲近。
两人很久都没有在一起了，自然也没能够这样亲热，她的吻就像是油里面的一簇火星，瞬间点燃了所有的热情。
他抱着她，将她压制在了墙体与他之间，狠狠地亲吻着她的双唇。呼吸，一下子乱了节奏。
就连房间里的温度好像都上升了好几个度。
许久，君雅思感觉自己快要溺死在他爱意之中，他这才松开了她几分。
微喘。“我做了饭，我们吃饭吧？”
虽然说她也很想就这样拉着他将事情给办了，但是她心里清楚的很，这男人不灌醉，他压根就不会跟自己在一起。
在他想来就一定是要跟自己结婚了之后，才能够真正在一起。
她也不知道自己怎么交往了这么一个老古董的男朋友。当然，心里也是因为他能够这样尊重自己而感觉到高兴。
但真正两个人相处在一起了，总会想着跟他进一步。
顾少卿没有放开她，不过却也没有其他进一步的动作，只是抱着她的手收紧了几分。
张口回应，但是那声音明显已经染上了情-欲，低沉嘶哑，却又性感的致命。
忍住，不能够在这个时候将他扑到，否则的话，那后果就是成功不了。
对于这一点，君雅思看的相当通透。
餐桌上，看着桌子上的西餐，顾少卿的眸子里染上了浓郁的笑容。
“你的厨艺倒是比以前好了很多。”
说着，他脱掉了西装外套，放置在了一旁的沙发上这才坐在了餐桌上。
夜小念给他倒了一杯红酒，给自己也倒了一杯。
对于顾少卿的夸赞，君雅思毫不客气的承认，那也是相当自信了。
瞧着她的样子，顾少卿眸子里的笑容越发的深了几分。
“怎么回来不提前给我打个电话，我也好早一点回来。”本来他几天是没有什么事情的，想着下班，回来也看不到她，所以就回来的稍微晚一点。
君雅思嘻嘻一笑，带着几分神秘与俏皮。“就是想给你一个惊喜。”
她的模样落在顾少卿的眼中是如此的娇俏可爱，特别是那双眸子里的灵动，就这样让他的心跟着一阵阵的悸动。
他握着酒杯的手收紧了几分，看着眼前她让他有种恨不能就此刻将她拥入怀中。
可是君雅思将酒杯递给了他之后，可就已经抽身坐会了自己的位置。
好歹是自己做的，她自然是希望能够得到他的夸赞，毕竟她也是个小女人，喜欢自己男朋友对自己的夸赞。
顾少卿轻笑着将视线从她身上抽离出来，这才拿起了一旁的刀叉。他的动作矜贵而又优雅，涵养十足，君雅思看着他吃东西的样子，眼睛里也是盛满了小心心。

Chapter 1975 The rhythm suddenly changed (page 1)
Gu Shaoqing held her in his arms and prevented her from falling.
I was also very happy in my heart. "I miss you too." Jun Yasi slightly let go of Gu Shaoqing's neck and looked at the man in front of her, her heart almost overflowing with joy.
At this moment, I can't say any other words, I just want to be close to him.
The two hadn't been together for a long time, and naturally they couldn't be so intimate. Her kiss was like a cluster of sparks in oil, instantly igniting all the passion.
He hugged her, suppressed her between the wall and him, and kissed her lips fiercely. Breathing suddenly lost its rhythm.
Even the temperature in the room seemed to have risen several degrees.
For a long time, Jun Yasi felt like she was drowning in his love, and then he let go of her a little.
Panting slightly. "I cooked, let's eat?"
Although she wanted to just pull him and settle the matter, she knew very well that if this man didn't get drunk, he wouldn't be with her at all.
After he thought about it, he must marry himself before they could truly be together.
She didn't know how she ended up with such an old-fashioned boyfriend. Of course, I was also happy because he could respect me in this way.
But when two people really get along, they will always want to go further with him.
Gu Shaoqing didn't let go of her, but he didn't make any further moves. He just tightened his hold on her.
He opened his mouth to respond, but the voice was obviously tainted with lust. It was low and hoarse, but sexy and deadly.
Hold back and don't pounce on him at this time, otherwise, the consequence will be that you will not succeed.
Jun Yasi has a very clear view on this point.
At the dining table, looking at the Western food on the table, Gu Shaoqing's eyes were filled with a rich smile.
"Your cooking skills are much better than before."
As he spoke, he took off his suit jacket, placed it on the sofa nearby, and then sat at the dining table.
Ye Xiaonian poured him a glass of red wine and poured a glass for herself.
Regarding Gu Shaoqing's praise, Jun Yasi admitted it unceremoniously, which was quite confident.
Looking at her look, the smile in Gu Shaoqing's eyes became deeper and deeper.
"Why don't you call me in advance when you come back so that I can come back earlier." Originally, he had nothing to do for a few days. He thought he would not be able to see her when he got off work, so he came back a little later.
Jun Yasi smiled, a bit mysterious and playful. "I just want to give you a surprise."
Her appearance was so cute and cute in Gu Shaoqing's eyes, especially the agility in her eyes, which made his heart throb.
His hand holding the wine glass tightened a little, and looking at her in front of him made him wish he could hold her in his arms right now.
But after Jun Yasi handed him the wine glass, he had already withdrawn and sat down in his seat.
After all, she did it herself, so she naturally hopes to get his praise. After all, she is also a little woman and likes her boyfriend to praise her.
Gu Shaoqing chuckled and took his eyes away from her, then picked up the knife and fork beside him. His movements were noble, elegant, and full of self-cultivation. Jun Yasi looked at the way he was eating, and his eyes were full of care.
